name: GRX Di2 RX717 / RX827
use_case: Fully wireless 1x12 gravel with a 10-51T cassette
positioning: Wide-range wireless gravel: RX717 is the value version and RX827 the tougher premium version, both distinct from wired 2x RX825.
architecture: Fully wireless shifting with a removable protected battery in the rear derailleur; no internal derailleur battery wiring.

weight.note: No normalized package total is recorded; RX717 and RX827 component weights must remain revision-specific.

battery: Removable rear-derailleur battery shared across the current RX717/RX827-compatible Shimano wireless family; lever controls use their own cells.
controls_and_app: Wireless Di2 control; Automatic Impact Recovery and SHADOW ES-style protection are part of the current rear-derailleur family.
package_summary: A usable conversion needs the matching right shift/brake lever, left brake lever, RD battery and charger, 10-51T cassette, chain, crank/chainring and hydraulic brakes.

compatibility.hanger: Conventional replaceable hanger; UDH is not required
compatibility.frame: No internal electronic wire route; verify normal hanger clearance and 1x chainline

china_price_status: No attributable exact mainland RX717 or RX827 package price captured in this batch.
caveats: The 10T start requires a Micro Spline-compatible wheel or freehub body.
This is 1x only and has larger cadence steps than a 2x road/all-road setup.
Do not label the normal-hanger RX827 as SRAM-style UDH Full Mount.
